probes.protocol: Embeddings from all three task splits are pooled and split 50/50 for the probe. The task's own partition is not reused, because a strict protocol makes the nuisance disjoint across it by construction.
probes.note: No adversarial nuisance is configured for this run, so the probe measures how much nuisance information the embedding retains without any pressure to remove it. That is the reference point the ablation compares against.
